routing.ambience: player -8 dB -> Music -10 dB -> Master -4 dB

runtime.missing_music_behavior: No replacement or fallback; previous stream continues if one exists. Every current world has a track.
runtime.missing_ambience_behavior: Existing ambience stops; absent new ambience stays silent. Hub/confluence have no ambient file by design (generator produces four named world ambiences).
runtime.missing_effect_behavior: Returns silently. All eight explicitly requested action names exist.
runtime.source_waveform_vs_imported_note: ffmpeg checks source delivery assets. Imported Godot resources are separately present; source WAV PCM is not proof of post-import decoding.
runtime.peak_bounds_note: Conservative aligned individual peaks; not an observed mix or evidence of clipping. Six-effect ceiling alone does not prove a reachable same-phase maximum.
